move: number counts up with expo ease, pops on landing, confetti bursts
how: A square dark card with a violet radial glow, a three-bar Figma-style logo, a 300px tabular numeral, a label and a violet 'Thank you' pill. The logo bars pop in from scale 0 / x -20 with back.out(2) and 0.08s stagger in the first 17%; the numeral fades up from scale .9 and a proxy value tweens 0 to 1000 with expo.inOut over 53% of the duration, written each frame as a locale-formatted string. At 60% the number pops to scale 1.1 (0.12s) and relaxes with elastic.out(1,.35), the pill springs in with back.out(2), the glow expands scale .8 to 1.2 with expo.out, and 60 seeded confetti rectangles fly out radially 260 to 640px with random rotation, fading over 0.9 to 1.3s (power2.out). At 90% everything lifts and fades (y -20, power2.in) to the glow alone.
adapt: Change the target number, the label, pill text, brand mark and the confetti/glow palette; format via toLocaleString or a custom formatter. Keep the expo.inOut count with the pop-and-elastic landing and the confetti burst timed to the landing.
port: mount(el, shot) renders glow, logo, .num, label, pill and an empty confetti container; animate(el, shot, D) returns a gsap.timeline with the count tween (onUpdate writing textContent) from 0.07D for 0.53D, landing at 0.6D, and the 60 confetti fromTo tweens generated with a seeded rng so renders are deterministic. Replace getElementById with el.querySelector.
caveats: 60 confetti elements are tweened individually; fine, but generate with a seeded rng
from() tweens need immediateRender:false if built lazily
